propositions: Signed material pins must be registered as a validity check across all plan-review attestation consumers while maintaining backward compatibility with unpinned legacy attestations.
An optional configuration key `enforce_plan_material_pins` gates whether pin drift/staleness/malformation invalidates attestations versus reporting them as advisory health.
Pin health must be derived and reported as a structured contract before existing invalidation checks, exposing simultaneous drift even when other conditions control the verdict.
Configuration read failures for the optional enforcement key must fail open, emit a structured warning, and never raise an exception.
Re-sign recovery must validate review-time related-material records from the sidecar without requiring a certified attestation, blocking re-sign only when enforcement is enabled and pins are invalid.
Drift-refresh candidates must delegate all validity checks including pin enforcement to a shared compute_validity function rather than duplicating inline validation.
